name: Apartment List API
tagline: Rental inventory and lead APIs for multifamily marketing partners
description: Apartment List provides partner APIs for multifamily marketing: rental inventory, lead generation, and property data integration. Designed for property managers, marketers, and tech partners who need structured access to listing and lead workflows—not a self-serve public consumer API.

auth.details: Partner API credentials issued after partnership approval; not self-serve. Exact header/scheme not fully published on public partner pages.

pricing.paid_plans: Enterprise/partner pricing; contact sales via partners page

use_cases: sync multifamily rental inventory for marketing partners
submit or receive rental leads from partner channels
look up property listing details for partner dashboards
integrate Apartment List inventory into property management tools
